{{Top}}
A '''hypercomm''' was a form of [[Hyperwave/Legends|hyperwave]] communications. It could be active on multiple channels at once. Hypercomms were used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], by Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] and by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Lord Vader used a hypercomm suite during his search for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] to communicate instantly with [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in full real-time holograph format. It was also rumored that there was a hypercomm installed in the Emperor's personal shuttle.
